open_items: ILO references:contentconstraint broken (500) at cycle 274, second occurrence of this assertion flapping (first was a same-cycle blip at cycle 199, no recurrence through 271). Live recheck at report time (00:44Z) got ignored/200 in 4 of 5 tries and one 403, disagreeing with the cycle's observed 500, consistent with ILO's known WAF/Cloudflare flakiness rather than a durable change. Watch cycle 275 to confirm it reads ok/ignored again; escalate if broken persists beyond one cycle or recurs a third time.
